name: PivotBank API
description: POST a bank statement PDF and get back every transaction as JSON: date, description, money out, money in, running balance, the page it was printed on, and whether the statement's own running balance vouches for it. One endpoint. Requires a Pro subscription and an API key from https://pivotbank.app/account/api-keys. Every response carries X-Pages-Left, the pages remaining in the plan's monthly allowance. Every response carries RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Policy for the plan's monthly page allowance. The API is versioned in the path; a version is never changed in place, and a retiring version would carry Deprecation and Sunset headers for at least six months.
